FSA838-06816n[ TT. $ 2264.一 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this"Agreement"), made as of November 16,2015, by and between 75 Monroe Street,LLC with an address at 55Watermill Lane, Great Neck,NY 11021 (hereinafterreferred to as"Owner") and USA Senwell Fund Management LLC, having an address at 60 Henry Street, New York, NY 10002 (hereinafter referred to as "Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owneris the owner infee title of a certainparcelofland,with thebuildings and improvements thereon, in New York County, City and State of New York, known as Block 274 Lot 14 and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part of hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Land"; said buildings and improvements, if any, together with anyfuture additions,alterations and replacements thereofbeing hereinafterreferred to as "Owner's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Property"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in New York County, City and State of New York, known as 274 Lot 24 and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land and tax lots being referred to herein as "Developer's Land"; and said land and buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof and any other adjacent land and buildings and improvements hereinafter acquired byDeveloper or any affiliates thereof,being hereinafterreferred to as "Developer's Property"); Owner's Land and Developer's Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the"Parcels"and each individually as a"Parcel") WHEREAS, Developer intends, either through Developer or an affiliate thereof constructed a new building(s) upon all or a portion of Developer's Land said new building(s), with any further additions, alterations and replacements thereof, being collectively herein called the "New Building"; WHEREAS,it Developer seeks to increase the amount of commercial floor area within the New Building (herein referred to as "Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of NewYork effective December 15,1961(the"Zoning Resolution") than is now available for use under the"floor area ratio" limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution related to Developer's Land as an independent "zoning lot", with the result that Developer desires to utilize the procedure availableunder the Zoning Resolution for combining Developer's Land and Owner's Land into a single"zoning lot" for the purpose of determining compliance by the New Building with such limitation; 1

WHEREAS,there exist,or there mayhereafter exist,FloorAreaDevelopmentRights (hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to Owner's Land which are in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by Owner's Building at the present time and the same are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution. As used in this Agreement, the term"Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of such zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which such zoning lot is located,and (i) the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City of NewYork (the "City"); WHEREAS,in order to construct the NewBuilding with the excess bulk on Developer's Land, Owner hereby transfers toDeveloper 3234 square feet of commercialFloor Area Development Rights attributable to Owner's Land (the“Transfer Development Rights"), on the terms and conditions hereinafter set forth, it being understood and agreed, however, that Owner is retaining for its own benefit all Floor Area Development Rights required in order to maintain Owner's Building, as well as Development Rights being retained by Owner are referred to herein as the "Retained Development Rights"); NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of TenDollars ($10.00)and other good andvaluable follows: ARTICLEI DECLARATIONOFRESTRICTIONS Section 1.1. The parties hereto are, simultaneously herewith, executing and delivering a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions,as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (herein called the "Declaration"), a copy of which Declaration is annexed hereto as Exhibit B and made a part hereof, which seeks to effectuate the intentions of the parties set forth in the preamble to this Agreement by creating a single zoning lot (herein called the "Single Zoning Lot") comprising both Owner'sLandandDeveloper'sLand, ARTICLEII DEVELOPMENTRIGHTS Section 2.1.Owner hereby transfers and conveys toDeveloper the TransferDevelopment Rights and consents toDeveloper'sincorporation of said TransferDevelopment Rights into theNew Building and Developer's utilization of said Transfer Development Rights to developDeveloper's Land. Developer hereby acknowledges and agrees that Owner shall retain all rights in and to the Retained Development Rights and all other rights pertaining to Owner's Building and Owner's Property 2
